title: AAPS Watch bolus calc improvement - add calc to treatments tab
symptom: When bolusing from the AAPS watch, the calculation is not logged in the treatments tab, unlike boluses done from the phone calculator. This makes it impossible to see the calculation details, especially the percent used when caretakers adjust it.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit referenced by MilosKozak, which adds the calculation log to the treatments tab for watch boluses. The fix is now in the dev version and will be in the next master version.
